learning_outcomes.text: Practice of small parts production using micromachining, watchmaker lathe, thin layers steaming, holography technique, grid production and glass machining, optical fibers production, single crystal production, springs, tooth gearing.

syllabus_topics: The watch lathe, automatic Swiss type lathe
Statistical production of balls and the production and assembly of bearings
Production of spherical surfaces, three-phase optical technology, production of aspherical surfaces
Production of springs and spring elements for instruments
Techniques surveying and production of holes
Special technologies for production instrument components - lasers, ultrasound techniques, EDM
Technology of gluing and production of composites
bibliography: Skripta Technologie přístrojové techniky, Doc. Šulc
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
